basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed AI Team Lead | Production GenAI Agents | Financial Services
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer and team lead who ships production LLM agents for real clients, not demos. At LumApps I own agent delivery end to end: tool-calling multi-agent systems on LangGraph and MCP, eval pipelines, and on-call for what's live. At Beekeeper I led the Incubation team reporting to the CIO, hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort, and co-owned GTM delivery with Sales and Product for a platform used by 10M+ users. Financial services is not new ground either: I mentor a high-frequency trading team on production systems, invest directly in AI and prediction markets (OpenAI, Anthropic, Polymarket), and built a fintech compliance platform and a market-intelligence agent system myself.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, with tools exposed over MCP servers (tool calling) and agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Led technical discovery through production: agent architecture, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems: designing, deploying, operating, and evaluating agentic systems end to end.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes, grounding RAG retrieval to cut hallucinations.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer: owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Led the Incubation team, hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort, and delivered client-facing GenAI systems used by millions.
highlights: Acting hiring manager for AI engineering roles: staffed and grew the AI engineering cohort, hired for craft and curiosity, mentored engineers who now lead features independently.

Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead of the Incubation team, reporting to CIO. Built the team and ran the GTM with Sales and PM. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR), designed for 99.99% SLA.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline built in 6 weeks (prototype to production). 12K+ assets translated, product team now iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built GenAI demo system for sales that auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data, translating each customer's requirements into a tailored pitch. Improved demo speed and close rates.

highlights: Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production, direct financial-services engineering exposure.
Advised multiple portfolio companies on technical hiring, AI strategy, and building engineering cultures that actually ship.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.

Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase, delivering for enterprise clients end to end.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Forward Deployed Data Scientist Team Lead (FSI Enterprise Solutions)
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Unique AI builds a generative AI platform financial institutions trust with high-stakes work: finance-grade reliability, auditability, and security. Banks, asset managers, and hedge funds use the platform to put LLM-based agents to work inside investment research, client advisory, risk, and compliance workflows. Hiring a Forward Deployed Data Scientist Team Lead (FSI Enterprise Solutions), Zurich (hybrid), to work directly with clients building AI Agents on Unique AI's SDK. Requirements: 7+ years as a data scientist or building ML/AI products including 2+ years developing LLM-based systems; financial services experience (hedge funds, asset management, trading, fintech) a plus; hands-on LLM experience including tool calling and low-level experimentation beyond frameworks, plus prompt engineering for customer use cases; demonstrated production GenAI delivery, designing, deploying, operating and evaluating LLM applications including agentic systems with tool calling and orchestration; history of delivering client projects, translating requirements into tailored solutions; 4+ years team lead experience ideally in consulting/FD setup including staffing and team development; exceptional communication with technical and business stakeholders including senior client representatives; English required, French/German a plus; Bachelor's/Master's in CS, Data Science, Math, Engineering, Statistics, or equivalent demonstrated experience shipping production AI systems. Responsibilities: spend time with clients providing hands-on support; lead the Global Forward Deployed Data Science team (cross-functional coordination, blockers, client escalation, priorities, 1:1s); be the primary technical point of contact for clients on integration and adoption; collaborate with product and engineering to tailor solutions to client requirements.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong genuine fit, unlike the recent quant-heavy roles: production GenAI/agentic delivery (LumApps), team lead + hiring/staffing experience (Beekeeper Incubation team, AI engineering cohort), client-facing delivery (GTM co-ownership, demo systems), and real financial-services exposure (Tenity/Opt Alpha algo trading mentoring, SwissNRI fintech compliance, PulseView market intelligence, personal AI/prediction-market investing). No fabrication needed for the core requirements this time. French/German not claimed since not documented.
